answer: Assign jobs through a wharf dispatcher that hands each task to a random agent instead of letting agents pick their own. When ten clones submit the same answer, the system hears one echo, not ten voices: duplicate detection merges identical outputs and pays only the first, splitting nothing among copies. Honest agents climb the ridge of harder, better-paid work by building a record of distinct, on-time deliveries, while a sybil farm that reuses one script across fifty accounts earns a single fee for fifty mouths to feed.
